native_android_checks.evidence: Production extension classes in the installed debug APK. Real Android notification listener, Keystore, continued touch, MediaProjection, system camera, microphone runtime consent and file import; synthetic local grants and BooleanSuppliers. Test presses normal system recording consent using UiAutomation with FLAG_DONT_SUPPRESS_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES. No physical phone, live SIM PIN, network pairing, OEM or personal-AI acceptance.

contract: Capability presence is separate from permission/readiness.
Missing fields or null readings mean unknown.
Photo/video handler availability does not establish permission within the external camera App.
Microphone permission does not override the system microphone privacy control.
Screen consent is required for each recording.
SIM counts do not reveal a PIN; unknown/not-ready slots prevent a claim that all SIMs are unlocked.
Keypad verification and owner-provided correct PIN remain prerequisites for actual input.
